newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee quiet vs dlr in spot, gains in fwd.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee quiet vs dlr in spot, gains in fwd.

text.p: The Indian rupee was steady against the dollar in late morning trade Wednesday in spot deals while it edged up in the forward market, dealers said.
They said trade in the spot market was dull and the rupee was largely stuck between 35.77 and 35.78 per dollar.
"It is quite dull at the moment," said a dealer. "The rupee is stuck in a broad 35.77-35.78 range but there has been little trade."
In latest deals, the dollar was quoted at 35.775/780 rupees after opening 35.765/775.
The rupee gained marginally against the forward dollar on easier domestic liquidity, dealers said.
They said forward premiums fell by at least 0.02 rupees for most months.
In latest deals, December-delivery dollars were quoted at a premium of 0.57/0.60 rupees against Tuesday's close of 0.61/62.
